summary: Master CRE loan structuring, underwriting, and debt sizing. Learn to build credit memorandums and manage risk in commercial property finance. Enroll today.
lede: Commercial real estate loan structuring helps you design debt instruments around property-level cash flows, lender risk appetites, and capital market requirements. This course develops practical skills in debt sizing with DSCR, capitalization-rate analysis, capital-stack design, and mezzanine financing waterfalls. You will build sensitivity models for vacancy shocks, interest-rate caps, liquidity shifts, and tightening credit spreads while exploring loan covenants, ESG-linked lending criteria, automated underwriting workflows, and Basel III and IV frameworks. Through applied templates and frameworks, you will learn to present cohesive credit narratives and create resilient structures that support both lender protection and borrower operations.
audienceIntro: This program is essential for professionals responsible for the deployment and management of capital within the commercial property sector.
modules: CRE Market Fundamentals and NOI Analysis
Debt Sizing Metrics and Financial Ratios
ESG and Green Financing in CRE
The Credit Memorandum and Stakeholder Pitch
prerequisites: Participants should have a foundational understanding of real estate finance and be proficient in Microsoft Excel. Experience in basic credit analysis or property management is recommended. Familiarity with standard financial statements (Balance Sheet, P&L) is required.
